steps.note: Open a create flow suitable for an event with an evaluation period.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the technical-stage template before completing the stage.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Complete the technical questionnaire so the stage can be published.
Assign the evaluator required for technical evaluation.
Commit the event schedule before publication.

args.goal: In the Schedule side panel, under Evaluation Time, open the Duration dropdown, choose the 30 Mins preset, save the schedule, and stop with the saved Evaluation Time showing 30 Mins

steps.note: Set the requested evaluation duration because no catalog domain step can configure Evaluation Time during initial scheduling.
Verify that the selected evaluation duration is shown after saving.
Add the participant required to publish and submit a technical response.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit a vendor technical response so evaluation can be exercised after the stage closes.
Verify that the technical response was accepted.
Close the technical round so its evaluation period becomes available.
Exercise the evaluator flow after the round ends, demonstrating that evaluation is available.
Confirm that the post-close evaluation flow completed without an application error.
